ios.desc:
M4Bindr: The Ultimate Audiobook Builder

Your MP3 files, turned into professional audiobooks.

M4Bindr is a powerful audiobook creator that lets you convert, merge, and organize audio files into the M4B format. Create a private library fully compatible with Apple Books and premium audiobook players.

One-time purchase. No subscriptions. No ads.

IMPORT: Bring Your Audio Together
Universal Import: Add files from the Files app, AirDrop, iCloud, or any iOS app.

Batch Import: Quickly import multiple MP3, M4A (AAC), and M4B files at once.

Smart Organization: Your raw files are ready to be stitched into a single, cohesive book.

BUILD: Advanced M4B Converter & Editor
Fast Conversion: High-speed MP3 to M4B conversion with efficient encoding.

Audio Joiner: Merge multiple MP3 and M4B files into a single, seamless audiobook.

Chapter Management: * Automatically turn each MP3 into a chapter.

Preserve chapters from imported M4B files.

Create, edit, or reorder chapters freely for a custom listening experience.

Metadata Editor: Add high-quality cover artwork and edit full metadata including Title, Author, Narrator, and Description.

EXPORT: Share & Listen Anywhere
Apple Books Ready: Exported files are optimized for Apple Books and all major audiobook players.

Efficient Files: Get smaller file sizes without sacrificing audio quality.

Easy Sharing: Save to your device or share directly via the iOS Share Sheet.

Why M4Bindr?
Perfect for combining lecture recordings, podcast episodes, or DRM-free downloaded audiobooks into one organized experience. Whether you are a student, a power listener, or a creator, M4Bindr gives you total control over your audio library.

Love M4Bindr? Leaving a review helps me keep the app independent and subscription-free!

quotes.text:
I built this because I had a library of DRM-free audiobooks as loose MP3 files — ripped CDs, Librivox recordings, purchases from DRM-free stores — and no good way to package them on iOS. Every solution either required a Mac, a third-party desktop app, or uploading files to a web service I didn't trust.

M4Bindr does the whole thing on-device. You import your tracks, reorder them, define chapters (manually or auto-generated per file), add cover art, fill in the metadata, and export a single .m4b that Apple Books and BookPlayer treat as a proper audiobook — with chapter navigation, resume position, the works.

It's not trying to handle DRM removal or format conversion beyond MP3/M4A — intentionally narrow scope. The goal was a clean, fast tool that does one thing well for people who already have the files and just want them packaged correctly.
Would love feedback, especially from anyone who has edge cases around large files or unusual chapter structures.
